answers.q1: This app is recording a meeting labeled '01:53の会議' (01 minute 53 second meeting). It is currently recording (shown by the red dot and '録音中 00:02' timer at top). The audio source is explicitly stated: 'マイクと画面の音を聞いています' — microphone and screen audio.

answers.q3: This is ONE application surface. It has a clean two-column layout: left column for meeting transcription and analysis, right column for AI-extracted outputs (summaries, decisions, actions). No window seams or separate applications are visible.
answers.q4: That the app is actively recording a meeting from mic and screen audio, and waiting to capture and analyze meeting content (decisions and action items). The red recording indicator and time counter make the active recording state the most prominent information.
answers.q5: Minor redundancy: '聞いています...' (Listening...) repeats the earlier '音を聞いています' (listening to audio). The large empty area on the right with 'まだ発話がありません。' reads as incomplete rather than calm. It's unclear what happens when speech is detected or how to interact with captured content. The purpose of the bottom section 'AIが見ている資料' is not immediately evident with no materials shown.
